entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Oh, hello? I... I think I need to return something. I'm not sure how this works.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Um, yes, I think so. It's... VF88-6-7-5-3-0-9. I bought some of your cycling shoes, and it's all just been very confusing.
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Pedal cycling shoes, delivered seven days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with them?

I just... I don't think they work for me. I wore them once and got terrible blisters on my heels. And I couldn't figure out the cleats at all. The website was so overwhelming. I just want to get a refund. Can't you just help me?
I'm very sorry to hear about the blisters, and I completely understand. Of course, I can help you with that. Let me just check the policy for you.
Okay, yes. Since you received the shoes just last week, you are well within the 90-day return period. I can absolutely process this return for you.
Oh, really? So I can send them back? What do I do?

Yes, absolutely. And I see you're a VIP member with us, so I'm happy to make this as easy as possible. I've just emailed a pre-paid return shipping label to you. Simply print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives the cycling shoes, a full refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
Wow, that's it? That's so much simpler. Thank you so much, David. I was so worried.
It's my pleasure to help. We want to make sure you're happy, even if a product isn't the right fit. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
